relationships.qualifier: Emission/propagation below the local plasma frequency is suppressed, so observed plasma-emission frequencies diagnose electron density (ionosondes, solar type III bursts).
In general relativity mass-energy curves spacetime; a black hole is the extreme case where the event horizon encloses a region no path leads out of.

Cellular function depends on protein structure; expression level sets how much functional protein is available.

relationships.qualifier: Disease-relevant mutations start a chain: altered protein -> altered cell function -> tissue dysfunction -> clinical progression (e.g. colorectal adenoma-carcinoma sequence).

relationships.qualifier: Both are periodic phenomena described by a characteristic period: Keplerian orbits by T^2 = (4 pi^2 / GM) a^3, circadian rhythms by an endogenous ~24 h molecular clock. The shared abstraction is a robust oscillator; the physics differs completely (gravitational two-body dynamics versus gene-regulatory feedback), so any cross-mapping is a conceptual analogy, not evidence.

source.title: CROSS-DOMAIN ESSAY: Britannica, 'Kepler's laws of planetary motion'; Dunlap, J. C. 1999, Cell 96, 271 (circadian clocks)

relationships.qualifier: The delayed TTFL feedback loop of clock genes produces the ~24 h physiological rhythm.
Transcription factors binding promoters/enhancers set transcription rates — the primary control point of expression.

source.title: Alberts, B. et al., Molecular Biology of the Cell, 6th ed., ch. 7

relationships.qualifier: Both map recurring cycles onto lived time: the ~24 h molecular clock in organisms versus the classical Tamil division of the day/night and seasons into akam landscape-times. A structural parallel for comparative study — it is NOT scientific evidence for either system.

relationships.qualifier: Cosmology describes stars, structures and the universe itself as changing irreversibly over time; classical puram poetry meditates on the impermanence of human life and monuments. Both treat change over time, but the poem is a human reflection, not a physical model — labelled ANALOGY, not evidence.
